units.source_text: 丰盈圆润而又朦胧的裸体，在昏暗的腾腾热气中，用膝盖爬行着，活像一群光滑而黏糊的动物。

en.t: Plump, rounded, and hazy naked bodies crawled on their knees through the dim, billowing steam, looking just like a group of smooth, sticky animals.

units.source_text: 唯有肩上丰满的肌肉抽搐着，一派农忙时的景象。

en.t: Only the full muscles on their shoulders twitched, like a scene from the busy farming season.

units.source_text: 黑发的色泽又映出一幅人间的图景——简直是水灵灵的，高贵而又悲伤。

en.t: The sheen of their black hair, too, reflected a vision of the human world, fresh and glistening, noble and sad.

units.source_text: 这是多么艳丽的人间图景啊。

en.t: What a dazzling vision of the human world it was.
